combat_audio_visual_feedback.off_screen_bullet_trails: Enhanced visibility of off-screen bullet trails to locate elevated/concealed shooters

functionality: Enemy info masked during photo mode
Photo frames and sticker overlays upon sharing

features: Priority top placement in public room list

training_grounds_and_tactical_updates.training_grounds_chest: Combined weapons, items, and attachments into a unified purchase chest
training_grounds_and_tactical_updates.training_grounds_gloo_wall_reward: Grants 1 Gloo Wall for every 3 eliminations (resets upon elimination)
training_grounds_and_tactical_updates.vehicle_map_marking: Players can now mark map locations while actively driving
